title: pavonia palmata
intro: Pavonia palmata, commonly known as Rose Mallow or Velvet Leaf, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pavonia palmata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Pavonia palmata are believed to be responsible for its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
